description: A Chrome extension for tracking daily goals with timers, counters, and checkboxes. See FEATURES.md for full specifications.

userStories.title: Fix Footer Position When Few Goals
userStories.description: In the Daily Goals screen, when there are few or no goals, the bottom navigation buttons (Manage Goals, Reports) should remain at the bottom of the popup. Currently they float up when there's not enough content. Use flexbox with flex-grow on the content area or min-height to ensure footer stays at bottom.
acceptanceCriteria: Footer buttons stay at bottom regardless of goal count
Content area scrolls when many goals
Layout remains consistent across all scenarios

userStories.title: Compact View Mode for Daily Goals
userStories.description: Add a compact view option for the Daily Goals screen. Currently shows expanded goal cards. Create a toggle (icon button) to switch between expanded and compact views. Compact view: smaller cards, less padding, title + progress only, inline controls. Store preference in settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Toggle button to switch views (expand/collapse icon)
Compact view shows: title, type icon, progress bar, essential controls
Both views remain functional for all goal types

userStories.title: Dynamic Goal Form Fields Based on Type
userStories.description: In the Add/Edit goal form, show only relevant fields based on selected goal type. Timer: show hours/minutes inputs. Counter: show target count input. Checkbox: hide target inputs (target is always 1). Currently all fields show regardless of type selection.
acceptanceCriteria: Timer selected: show hours/minutes inputs only
Counter selected: show target count input only
Checkbox selected: hide all target inputs
Edit mode pre-selects type and shows correct fields

userStories.title: Full-Page Add/Edit Goal Screen
userStories.description: Replace the modal/popup for Add/Edit goal with a dedicated full-page screen. Better UX, more space for form fields, consistent with app navigation pattern. Add to SCREENS enum, create render function, update navigation from Manage Goals screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Full-page layout with header (back button, title)
All form fields from current modal
Back navigation returns to Manage Goals

userStories.title: Drag-to-Reorder Daily Goals
userStories.description: Allow users to reorder goals in the Daily Goals screen by dragging. Use HTML5 drag and drop API. Update goal.order property and persist to storage. Visual feedback during drag.
acceptanceCriteria: Drag handle visible on goal cards
Works in both expanded and compact views

userStories.title: UI Design Document
userStories.description: Create a comprehensive UI design document (plans/DESIGN.md) defining consistent patterns: spacing system, typography scale, color usage, button styles, form patterns, card layouts, icons, animations. Document current inconsistencies and propose fixes.

userStories.title: Refactor UI to Match Design Document
userStories.description: Apply the design document standards consistently across all screens. Fix spacing inconsistencies, standardize button styles, ensure consistent typography, align elements properly. This is a comprehensive UI polish pass.
acceptanceCriteria: All spacing uses design system values

userStories.title: Fix Stats Group Alignment in Daily Goals
userStories.description: In the Daily Goals screen header, the stats group (completed count, streak) are misaligned. Fix alignment using proper flexbox, ensure consistent spacing, vertical alignment of icons and text.

userStories.title: Fix Completion Checkmark Overlay Position
userStories.description: When a goal is completed, a checkmark/tick appears on the card. Currently it overlays and covers other content/data on the card. Reposition the checkmark to not obscure important information - consider corner placement, smaller size, or semi-transparent background.

userStories.title: Enhanced Completion Confetti
userStories.description: Improve the confetti animation when a goal is completed. Make it more celebratory and satisfying. Consider: more particles, better colors, longer duration, or use canvas-confetti library pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: Duration is satisfying but not too long
Optional: different intensity for different achievements

userStories.title: Goal Categories with Color Coding
userStories.description: Allow users to assign categories to goals (work, health, learning, personal, etc.). Each category has a color. Goals display category color as a side stripe or badge. Add category filter in View Goals screen. Category management in Settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Predefined categories with colors (work=blue, health=green, learning=purple, personal=orange)
Custom category creation with color picker
Visual category indicator on goal cards
Filter goals by category in View Goals

userStories.title: Goal Templates
userStories.description: Provide pre-made goal templates for common goals. Templates include: 30min reading, 10k steps, 8 glasses water, 1hr exercise, meditation, etc. Quick-add from template gallery. Users can save their own goals as templates.
acceptanceCriteria: Template gallery screen/modal accessible from Add Goal
At least 10 built-in templates across categories
One-tap to create goal from template
Save existing goal as template option
Templates include title, type, target, timeframe, category

userStories.title: Focus Mode
userStories.description: Add Focus Mode that hides all goals except one selected goal. Helps users concentrate on a single task. Toggle from goal card or header. Shows timer prominently. Exit returns to normal view.
acceptanceCriteria: Focus button on each goal card
Focus mode shows single goal prominently
Large timer/counter display in focus mode
Easy exit back to normal view

userStories.title: Quick Add Floating Button
userStories.description: Add a floating action button (FAB) for quick goal creation. Available on View Goals screen. Opens a minimal quick-add form with just title and type. Full form accessible via 'More options' link.
acceptanceCriteria: Quick form: title, type selector, save button
More options link to full form

userStories.title: Goal Archive System
userStories.description: Allow users to archive goals instead of deleting. Archived goals hidden from main view but preserved. Archive screen to view/restore archived goals. Useful for seasonal or completed long-term goals.
acceptanceCriteria: Archive option in goal menu (alongside edit/delete)
Archived goals removed from View Goals
Archive screen accessible from Manage Goals

userStories.title: Export/Import Data
userStories.description: Allow users to export all data (goals, history, settings) as JSON file. Import to restore from backup or transfer to new device. Accessible from Settings screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Downloads JSON file with all data
Merge or replace options on import

userStories.title: Individual Goal Statistics
userStories.description: Add detailed statistics view for each individual goal. Shows: completion rate over time, best streak, total time/count, average daily progress, chart of progress history. Accessible from goal card menu.

userStories.title: Weekly Review Screen
userStories.description: Add a weekly review screen summarizing accomplishments. Shows: goals completed, total time tracked, streaks maintained, highlights and achievements. Accessible from Reports or as weekly prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: Weekly Review screen in Reports section
Total time tracked across all timers

userStories.title: Custom Goal Colors
userStories.description: Allow users to assign custom colors to individual goals (independent of category). Color picker in goal form. Goal card displays with chosen accent color. Helps visual organization.
acceptanceCriteria: Works with both light and dark modes

userStories.title: Goal Notes and Description
userStories.description: Add optional notes/description field to goals. Useful for context, instructions, or motivation. Displayed on goal card (collapsed by default), expandable. Editable from goal form.

userStories.title: Customizable Reset Times
userStories.description: Allow users to customize when daily/weekly/monthly goals reset. Default midnight, but configurable. Useful for night owls or different time zones. Setting per goal or global default.
acceptanceCriteria: Global reset time setting in Settings
Clear indication of next reset time

userStories.title: Browser Notifications for Reminders
userStories.description: Add optional browser notifications to remind users about goals. Configurable reminder times per goal or global schedule. Uses Chrome notifications API. Can be enabled/disabled in settings.
acceptanceCriteria: Notification shows goal title and progress

userStories.title: Motivational Quotes
userStories.description: Display motivational quotes in the app. Show on: empty state, goal completion, weekly review. Curated collection of productivity/motivation quotes. Optional setting to disable.

userStories.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
userStories.description: Add keyboard shortcuts for common actions. Space to start/stop timer, +/- for counters, N for new goal, arrow keys to navigate goals. Help overlay shows available shortcuts.
acceptanceCriteria: Space: toggle active timer or checkbox
Shortcuts work when popup is focused

userStories.title: Undo/Redo Actions
userStories.description: Add undo/redo functionality for goal actions. Useful for accidental counter changes or timer stops. Toast notification with Undo button after actions. Redo available via Ctrl+Y or button.
acceptanceCriteria: Undo reverts: increment, decrement, toggle, timer start/stop

userStories.title: Achievements and Badges System
userStories.description: Implement a gamification system with achievements and badges. Users unlock badges for milestones: first goal, 7-day streak, 30-day streak, 100 goals completed, etc. Display badges in profile/achievements screen. Show unlock animation.
acceptanceCriteria: Achievements screen to view all (locked and unlocked)
Progress indicator for partially complete achievements

userStories.title: Daily Challenges
userStories.description: Add optional daily challenges for extra motivation. System generates random challenges: complete all goals before noon, maintain 2hr focus session, etc. Bonus XP/recognition for completing challenges.
acceptanceCriteria: Daily challenge displayed on View Goals screen

userStories.title: Share Progress as Image
userStories.description: Allow users to export their progress as a beautiful shareable image. Generate card showing: goals completed, streak, discipline score. Styled for social media sharing. Copy to clipboard or download.

userStories.title: Level and XP System
userStories.description: Add experience points (XP) and leveling system. Earn XP for completing goals, maintaining streaks, achievements. Level up with milestones. Display level badge prominently. Unlock features or themes at higher levels.
acceptanceCriteria: Bonus XP for streaks and achievements

userStories.title: Habit Chains - Linked Goals
userStories.description: Allow users to link goals in chains. Completing goal A enables/unlocks goal B. Useful for routines: wake up -> exercise -> meditate. Visual chain display. Chain completion bonus.
acceptanceCriteria: Link goals in sequence in goal form
Break chain to edit individual goals
Optional time delays between chain links

userStories.title: Pomodoro Timer Mode
userStories.description: Add built-in Pomodoro technique support for timer goals. 25min work + 5min break cycles. Visual indicator of current phase. Auto-transition between work and break. Configurable durations.
acceptanceCriteria: Pomodoro mode toggle for timer goals

userStories.title: Break Reminders
userStories.description: Add break reminders for long timer sessions. Configurable interval (e.g., every 45min). Gentle notification to stretch, rest eyes, hydrate. Can be snoozed or disabled per session.

userStories.title: Negative/Avoidance Goals
userStories.description: Add support for negative goals - things to avoid. Track days without doing something (no social media, no junk food). Counter increases automatically each day. Resets on slip-up with forgiveness option.
acceptanceCriteria: Forgiveness mode (1 slip allowed per week)
Different visual styling for avoidance goals

userStories.title: Productivity Insights
userStories.description: Analyze user patterns and provide actionable insights. Identify: most productive hours, best days, goal correlations. Display insights in Reports with recommendations.
acceptanceCriteria: Most productive time of day analysis

userStories.title: Goal Correlation Analysis
userStories.description: Analyze which goals are often completed together. Show correlations in Reports. Help users understand habit stacking. Suggest goal pairings based on data.

userStories.title: Monthly and Yearly Reports
userStories.description: Extend Reports with monthly and yearly summaries. Show long-term trends, total accomplishments, year-over-year comparison. Exportable annual review.

userStories.title: Streak Milestone Celebrations
userStories.description: Add special celebrations for streak milestones. Celebrate at 7, 14, 30, 60, 100, 365 days. Unique animations, badges, and messages for each milestone. Share milestone achievement.

userStories.title: Multiple Color Themes
userStories.description: Add multiple color themes beyond light/dark. Include: Ocean, Forest, Sunset, Midnight, Rose, Lavender. Theme selector in Settings with preview. Themes affect all UI colors.

userStories.title: Custom Sound Packs
userStories.description: Add multiple sound effect packs. Include: Default, Minimal, Retro, Nature, Sci-Fi. Sound pack selector in Settings with preview. Each pack has complete set of sounds.

userStories.title: Mini Widget Mode
userStories.description: Add ultra-compact mini mode for quick goal updates. Shows only active goals with minimal controls. Toggle from header. Useful for frequent check-ins without full UI.

userStories.title: Onboarding Tutorial
userStories.description: Add first-time user onboarding flow. Guide through: creating first goal, understanding goal types, using timer/counter, viewing reports. Skip option for experienced users.

userStories.title: High Contrast Mode
userStories.description: Add high contrast mode for visually impaired users. Increased contrast ratios, bolder borders, larger touch targets. Toggle in Settings under Accessibility.

userStories.title: Adjustable Font Sizes
userStories.description: Allow users to adjust text size globally. Options: Small, Medium (default), Large, Extra Large. Affects all text in the app. Setting in Accessibility.
acceptanceCriteria: No text truncation at large sizes

userStories.title: Reduced Motion Mode
userStories.description: Add reduced motion option for motion-sensitive users. Disables: confetti, transitions, hover animations. Respects prefers-reduced-motion system setting. Toggle in Accessibility.

userStories.title: Screen Reader Improvements
userStories.description: Enhance accessibility for screen reader users. Add comprehensive ARIA labels, roles, and live regions. Announce goal completions, timer updates. Test with popular screen readers.
acceptanceCriteria: ARIA labels on all interactive elements
